wish: someone should make a tool that steps through a video and extracts single frames
spec:
Opens a video file on the device and steps through it frame by frame, with a scrubber and play/pause.
Grab the current frame, or one frame every N seconds across the whole video; save each as PNG or JPG, or all as one .zip.
Does not upload anything, does not cut or convert the video, and only plays formats the browser can decode.
notes: The page CSP allows media only from data: URLs, so an opened file is read into a data: URL; very large files (several hundred MB) may run out of memory. Frame rate is estimated by decoding a few frames and can be corrected by hand.
